briefdescription.para: Sharding Module — Contract Hardening focused regression tests.

detaileddescription.para: Covers the normative contracts defined in include/sharding/sharding_api_contract.h across four acceptance-criteria tracks:

listitem.para: SCR-01..04 — Routing contract (consistent hash stability, rebalance, fallback under degraded topology)
SCR-05..08 — 2PC contract (prepare→commit, prepare→abort, double-commit safe, coordinator crash recovery to IN_DOUBT)
SCR-09..12 — WAL contract (append ordering, replay idempotent, corruption detection)
SCR-13..16 — Error contract (QUORUM_LOST on quorum loss, MIGRATION_CONFLICT, diagnostics non-null on failure, fail-closed classification)

detaileddescription.para: All infrastructure is fully in-process with deterministic stubs. Seed: kShardContractSeed = 42.
